name: Pepper Spray
description: TSA and airline rules for flying with pepper spray, mace, and self-defense sprays in carry-on and checked luggage.

carryOn.reason: Pepper spray, mace, and all self-defense chemical sprays are strictly prohibited in carry-on baggage and through TSA airport security checkpoints.

checkedBag.reason: One 4 fl. oz. (118 ml) container of pepper spray or mace is allowed in checked baggage only, provided it has a safety mechanism to prevent accidental discharge.
conditions: Limit of one container per passenger, maximum 4 fl. oz. (118 ml).
Must have a positive safety mechanism (e.g. twist-lock safety cap) to prevent accidental discharge in transit.
Must not contain more than 2 percent by mass of tear gas (CS or CN).
exceptions: Bear spray and animal repellent sprays with higher chemical concentrations are completely prohibited on passenger aircraft.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring pepper spray on a plane?

airlines.name: Delta Air Lines
airlines.notes: One 4 oz container permitted in checked baggage only with safety lock. Prohibited in cabin.

airlines.name: United Airlines
airlines.notes: One 118ml container permitted in checked luggage with safety trigger lock.

airlines.name: Southwest Airlines
airlines.notes: One 4 oz container of self-defense spray permitted in checked baggage with safety cap.

international.note: Pepper spray is classified as a prohibited weapon in the UK, Germany, Singapore, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Carrying pepper spray into these countries can lead to immediate arrest and felony weapon charges.

travelTips: Never pack pepper spray in your purse, backpack, or carry-on — TSA will confiscate it immediately at the checkpoint.
Make sure your checked pepper spray has a physical twist lock to avoid accidental discharge inside your suitcase.
Do NOT travel internationally with pepper spray under any circumstances.

faq.question: Can I bring pepper spray in my carry-on bag?
faq.answer: No. The TSA strictly prohibits pepper spray, mace, and all self-defense sprays in carry-on bags and on your person through airport security. If found in a carry-on, it will be confiscated.

faq.question: How do you pack pepper spray in checked luggage?
faq.answer: You may pack one 4 fl. oz. (118 ml) container in checked baggage. It must have an active safety mechanism (twist lock or flip top) to prevent accidental discharge during flight.

faq.question: Is bear spray allowed in checked luggage?
faq.answer: No. Bear spray contains higher concentrations of capsaicin and larger volume, and is completely prohibited on commercial passenger aircraft in both carry-on and checked luggage.
